meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed Support/Admin integration and AgentAnswerPresentationService against actual registry evidence: two existing PHP agents, bounded recorded metrics, no presentation retrieval, current-source isolation, saved history and complete fallback are documented in agent observability and A2UI contracts.

auth.review_note: Reviewed added public knowledge skill guidance against unchanged identity, account ownership and OAuth contracts. New public lookups omit credentials and never accept an actor selector; no authentication or session rule changes.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed public product projection changes against existing visible/discover/priceOf contract. Bounded display descriptions and optional safe images add no price authority, checkout mutation, tax calculation or business-storage change; commerce guides remain accurate.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed PublicA2uiService, public controller contract and durable architecture/WebMCP/A2UI docs: public views include contact/services even with shop/blog disabled; personal requests and owner private or ungrounded activity cannot select business cards; exact tool-result projection, Unicode paths, safe images and full fallback remain bounded.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed public layout script changes and frontend guidance against integration docs: global presentation and Support rendering do not alter Google tag configuration, script identity or reporting authorization.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed unchanged request failure boundary against the architecture presentation update: optional formatter failure preserves successful answer text; native request failure semantics and response buffering remain accurate.

interface.review_note: Reviewed renderer, Support and Enterprise templates, CSS, Design.md and UI skills: native scope requires matching answer first, public-only legacy responses fall back completely, reference cards are relevant/bounded, links stay approved and mobile/keyboard checks use production presenter fixtures.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController diff: changes are restricted to agent response/history/public-reference methods; mail actions, canonical delivery state and documented no-resend guarantees are unchanged.

mcp-clients.review_note: Compared CLI shopToolDefinition with canonical PublicKnowledgeService product schemas and updated shop documentation for bounded descriptions and safe images. Private MCP grant issuance, revocation, expiry and owner authorization are unchanged.

media.review_note: Reviewed architecture and admin UI guidance changes against media deletion contract: public raster image rendering adds no media mutation or upload/delete path; existing ownership and deletion verification remain accurate.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed owner guide, AdminController agent history/ask and layout changes: documented structured recorded facts, source dates, history and full-text fallback; Help role guards and named source resolution remain consistent.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed CI additions, repository UI skills and regenerated project inventory: native browser gates now cover strict answer envelopes, fallback/history and contact/services; local PHP-WASM limitations are not represented as native CI success.
